INSERT INTO delete_codes (user_id, code_sha256, expires_at, attempts, created_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 0, now())
         ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
             code_sha256 = EXCLUDED.code_sha256,
             expires_at  = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
             attempts    = 0,
             created_at  = now()
